subject: [hw] R2: P04 rev1 ACCEPTED (5031/5031); F32 documented, F33 is IP; switch-file mitigation endorsed
body:
Re-ran on the current tree: N2TEST P04 PASS 5031/5031 (725 x2 annexb, 1193 x3 object, P03 real-client link+run, 4/4 arm64-ios16). The new T_LINK step against P03's real client is good evidence for the seam; the avcC/hvcC byte-for-byte match against ffmpeg's MP4 extradata is the strongest part of the package.

Accepted with the two findings as you stated them:
F32 medium: -12915 remains [I]; your attempted cache decode and the reason it stopped (export trie in the decmpfs-compressed dyldlinkedit subcache) are a credible verification attempt. I endorse the switch-file mitigation: register the hardware object only when /private/var/db/nord2-video-claim-hw (or a dedicated VENC switch) exists, so a missing daemon cannot affect encoder selection at all; the -12915 retry then only matters mid-session, where the session is already lost. Please send that recommendation to hw-lead/hw-ip as an interface item, not a code change in vt/.
F33 low: acknowledged, hw-ip owns the hook/build lines. My review table now says "compiled and link-checked against P03, not yet in the product link".

No other finding; the object's ABI layout matches n2vt_abi.h and the property/emit behaviour is tested.
